badge_one: {{count}} Traefik object has a broken reference
badge_other: {{count}} Traefik objects have a broken reference

explain.noStatus: Traefik writes no status on its objects. Sextant checks what it can from the objects themselves: whether everything this object refers to exists.
explain.broken_one: {{count}} reference names an object that does not exist: Traefik skips what depends on it and logs an error.
explain.broken_other: {{count}} references name objects that do not exist: Traefik skips what depends on them and logs an error.
explain.emptyMatch: Route {{route}} has no match rule: Traefik skips it.
explain.unsupportedKind: Route {{route}} has the kind {{kind}}: Traefik supports only Rule and skips it.
explain.crossNamespace: A reference points into another namespace: Traefik follows it only when its Kubernetes CRD provider runs with allowCrossNamespace (off by default), a setting no object shows.
explain.otherProvider: A reference names an object of another Traefik provider (name@provider): Sextant cannot see it.
explain.unknown: Some lists could not be read: those references are not checked.
explain.ingressClass: Served only by a Traefik whose provider watches the ingress class {{name}}.
explain.certResolver: The certificate comes from the resolver {{name}} and is kept by Traefik, not in a Secret: Sextant cannot see it.

refState.crossNamespace: In another namespace: depends on allowCrossNamespace
refState.unknown: Cannot tell: the list could not be read

diagnose.noStatus: Traefik writes no status: each link is checked from the objects, and only a missing object counts as broken.
diagnose.ingressClass: Served only by a Traefik whose provider watches the ingress class {{name}}.
diagnose.allEntryPoints: Served on every entry point of Traefik.
diagnose.parents: Attached under the parent routes {{names}}: their own path is not followed here.
diagnose.unsupportedKind: The route has the kind {{kind}}: Traefik supports only Rule and skips the route.
diagnose.emptyMatch: The route has no match rule: Traefik skips it.
diagnose.noServices: The route names no service: only a parent of other routes works without one.
diagnose.weightZero: Its weight is 0: it gets no traffic.
diagnose.refMissing: {{kind}} {{name}} does not exist in the namespace {{namespace}}.
diagnose.refMissingNote: Traefik skips the route (its log says why): requests to it get 404.
diagnose.storeMissing: TLS store {{name}} does not exist; Traefik's routers do not use this reference.
diagnose.badKind: Service {{name}} has the kind {{kind}}: Traefik knows only Service and TraefikService and skips the route.
diagnose.refCrossNamespace: {{kind}} {{name}} exists in the namespace {{namespace}}, another than the route's.
diagnose.crossNamespaceNote: Traefik follows it only when its Kubernetes CRD provider runs with allowCrossNamespace (off by default), a setting no object shows.
diagnose.refOtherProvider: {{kind}} {{name}} belongs to another Traefik provider: Sextant cannot see it.
diagnose.refUnknown: Cannot tell whether {{kind}} {{name}} exists: its list could not be read.
diagnose.tooDeep_one: The TraefikServices nest deeper than {{count}} level: the rest is not followed.
diagnose.tooDeep_other: The TraefikServices nest deeper than {{count}} levels: the rest is not followed.
diagnose.tlsUnknown: Cannot read the certificate of the Secret {{name}}.
diagnose.tlsSecretMissing: The TLS Secret {{name}} does not exist in the namespace {{namespace}}.
diagnose.tlsDefaultNote: Traefik then serves its default certificate, which clients do not trust.
diagnose.tlsInvalid: The Secret {{name}} holds no valid certificate.
diagnose.tlsExpired: The certificate in the Secret {{name}} has expired.
diagnose.tlsNotYetValid: The certificate in the Secret {{name}} is not valid yet.
diagnose.tlsHostNotCovered: The certificate in the Secret {{name}} does not cover {{hosts}} (it is for {{names}}).
diagnose.tlsOk: The certificate in the Secret {{name}} is valid and covers {{hosts}}.
diagnose.tlsOkNoHosts: The certificate in the Secret {{name}} is valid.
diagnose.tlsResolver: The certificate comes from the resolver {{resolver}} and is kept by Traefik: Sextant cannot see it.
diagnose.tlsDefault: TLS without a Secret or a resolver: Traefik serves the default certificate of its TLS store.
